WITH DISTINCT o,

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ' ', 2) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ' ', 1) WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE 1 END AS birth_day
WITH o, 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age < 65 OR o.nationality <> 'Israeli-American'
